# Nodes with predicted available space less than 3 GB and disk write rate over 50 MB/s
(
  predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/"}[4h], 4 * 3600) < (3 * 1024^3)
  and
  rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total[4h]) * <average_write_size_in_bytes> > (50 * 1024^2)
)

# Calculate current usage rate of their root file systems
# Assuming `node_filesystem_size_bytes` is the total space metric
(
  (node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/"}) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/"} * 100
)
